# ADD Partners

> ADD Partners is a Romanian real-estate company that identifies, structures, and develops property opportunities for owners, investors, and partners.

The website is primarily in Romanian and presents current properties, land-acquisition services, real-estate development services, projects, and partnership opportunities.

## Main pages and sections

- [ADD Partners homepage](https://addpartners.ro/)
- [Current properties](https://addpartners.ro/#proprietati)
- [Services](https://addpartners.ro/#servicii)
- [Land acquisitions](https://addpartners.ro/#achizitii)
- [Real-estate developments](https://addpartners.ro/#dezvoltari)
- [Projects](https://addpartners.ro/#proiecte)
- [Investments and partnerships](https://addpartners.ro/#parteneriate)
- [About ADD Partners](https://addpartners.ro/#despre-noi)
- [Contact](https://addpartners.ro/#contact)
